text: I have something very serious to say about this app and apps like it, and it's a complaint, a very serious one. You guys have to design this app to not add things to it that people don't write or didn't say. It's one thing to correct a person's speech, but it's another whole different animal when you start adding things to people's text. I'm talking about two and three words sometimes. You say it's AI; I say it's ominous. It often adds words that corrupt the whole script and make it hostile towa
